settings.activations: held-out probe sequences (same as probe_curves); scatter-matrix SVD over all sequences x positions; centered_* subtracts the mean activation, uncentered_* does not
settings.erank: Roy & Vetterli 2007: exp(entropy of L1-normalised singular values)
settings.participation_ratio: (sum lambda)^2 / sum lambda^2 over covariance eigenvalues
settings.n90/n99: principal components needed for 90% / 99% of variance
settings.weights: per 2-D parameter (qkv split into q/k/v); encoder_* aggregates encoder.* params; distance_from_init is the L2 distance of encoder.* from rl_b10/initial_checkpoint
settings.aux_head_excess_nll: rl_b10_aux_ce only: held-out next-token NLL of the aux head minus the Bayes floor
